description:
### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord:** Fixed launch crash on Discord 354.12 by shipping a kotlin runtime shim, so Conduit extensions no longer reference the kotlin.jvm.internal classes newer Discord obfuscates away

patches.name: Conduit button on profile bar
patches.description: A shortcut to Conduit settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches.name: Conduit settings
patches.description: Adds Conduit to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.

patches.name: Hide blocked or ignored message rows
patches.description: Hides messages from blocked and ignored users entirely - no content, no divider.

patches.name: Hide blocked or ignored messages
patches.description: Removes the "blocked messages" and "ignored messages" rows from chat, and can hide replies to them too. From Rain.

patches.name: Hide gift button
patches.description: Hides the gift button in the chat message composer.

patches.name: Hide quest promo banner
patches.description: Hides the quest promo banner at the top of the server channel list.

patches.name: Pin app to built-in bundle
patches.description: Forces Discord to always run the bundle inside the APK and ignore downloaded (OTA) updates, which would otherwise silently undo the other patches. Turn this off (or update the APK) to receive official updates.

release_notes:
